training_evidence: v11 internal gain occurred on only9/18 days, bootstrap95%CI[-1.684444,12.124896]kW, post-selection descriptive only. Do not use outer results to choose another v11 checkpoint.
data: Same original raw labels, seven features, scaler fitted on first60% of outer-train, six turbines, input72/h2/stride3 and exact outer cohort. No input edits, label clipping, new data or sealed-test inference.
initializer: Reuse the exact original pretrain initializer only after verifying its fitting AND selection target hashes and latest outcome are available before the first70% training-origin issue. All origins start from that same initializer; no outer forecast checkpoint initializes neural training.
selection: One common architecture/config/epoch. At every one of three expanding origins both MAE and RMSE must be non-worse than that origin Persistence (1e-8 numerical tolerance only). Among eligible common choices minimize the equally weighted mean of per-origin mean MAE/RMSE ratios, requiring aggregate ratio<1-1e-8. Tie: fewer parameters, model name, earlier epoch. Never stitch per-origin best epochs or pick a candidate on outer validation.
fallback: Exact Persistence, explicitly zero learned skill, if no common choice passes. Fallback is not an optimization success.
outer_refit: Only selected architecture/config refit once on full original outer-train, from the same initializer, fixed common selected epoch and original20epoch cosine schedule. No outer selection, no retry with runner-up or best outer epoch.
primary_success: Same outer cohort: MAE and RMSE both improve vs Persistence and frozen original numerical base. Development result only; cross-fold independent confirmation still required before resuming Wiki.
budget: At most6 inner neural runs of20epochs and9 fixed Ridge fits plus one selected outer refit. Reuse completed v11 stages when the90% origin or selected full refit has identical windows, initializer, model, hyperparameters, implementation and epoch; verify hashes and record reuse. Reuse existing identical outer predictions only after rolling selection freezes and cohort matches. No repeated completed stages, extra seed or candidate.
resource_policy: Existing adaptive shared GPU policy; do not signal, reconfigure or throttle another user's process. No duplicate numerical suites.
limitations: Historically inspected development outer fold, not independent confirmation. This changes temporal selection and its compute budget, not a new physics/Wiki contribution. Multi-origin internal selection can still overfit and does not guarantee future gains. Do not treat old lower-data-budget baselines as capacity/budget-matched tuned SOTA.
